'''2020 TMW Round of 16 Jacy Smith LS This Is Getting Out Of Hand''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jacy Smith]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Round of 16).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jacy Smith]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open This Is Getting Out Of Hand Smi 2.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Round of 16
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-texas-mini-worlds/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20201027000438/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-texas-mini-worlds/ Internet Archive]
